sources.supports: Provider archive from 2026-09-09 lists the long-context tier for the model and its 2026-02-15 snapshot.
Current provider pricing page identifies the endpoint with the 2026-02-15 snapshot; the archived pricing page supplies its prices.

notes: The provider’s 2026-09-09 archive lists $0.5/$3 for 256K<Token≤1M on qwen3.5-plus and the 2026-02-15 snapshot, showing the tier by then. A Feb. 17, 2026 archive retrieval returned HTTP 429, and the available sources do not establish whether this tier applied at the start of models.dev’s recorded period; therefore the classification and effective date remain unclear.
